name: tickabee
description: Social media scheduler for drafting, reviewing, scheduling and publishing posts from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Tickabee connects ChatGPT to your social media accounts. Create content with AI, save drafts, review posts, and schedule or publish directly from your conversation.

Schedule posts to Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky and Google Business Profile, subject to connected-account eligibility and supported media and formats.

Create with AI. Publish with Tickabee.
Plan a week of content, write captions and save posts as drafts without manually copying them into a separate social media scheduler. ChatGPT helps create the content; Tickabee saves and publishes the posts.

Review before you publish.
Preview the saved caption, selected images, destinations and posting time. Keep a post as a draft, approve it for a future time, or explicitly request immediate publication. Scheduling and publishing require connection permission and an Owner or Publisher role. Saving a draft is not approval to publish.

Manage multiple brands and clients.
Use your existing Tickabee workspaces to keep each brand's voice, connected social accounts, drafts and team permissions separate. Create workspaces and connect social accounts in Tickabee before using them in ChatGPT.

Plan once. Publish across platforms.
Prepare posts for multiple connected networks, propose posting times, approve each saved post and check its recorded publishing results. Available actions depend on your plan, permissions and each network's requirements. Instagram requires media; YouTube requires video. X (Twitter) publishing requires an eligible plan and sufficient X credits.

AI drafts. You tick. Tickabee schedules and posts.

Image generation depends on ChatGPT and is not provided by this plugin. Image import requires a compatible ChatGPT file reference or an existing public HTTPS image URL, and stores only your selected image. Media URLs are publicly retrievable so social networks can download attachments.

Workspace and credit checks may initialize trial state, allocate eligible credits, expire grants or enforce existing Ambassador participation rules, including benefit revocation and an owner notification.
defaultPrompt: Draft a week of posts for my business in Tickabee. Save them as drafts for my review; do not schedule or publish.
Prepare next week's Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn posts. Ask for needed media and preview each before I approve scheduling.
Draft posts for my clients in their existing Tickabee workspaces. Show each post for review; do not publish.

positive.description: Discover accessible Hives and social accounts
positive.prompt: Show my Hives and the connected accounts in Tickabee Review.
positive.expected_behavior: Only accessible Hives and their connected accounts are returned. No accounts are connected and no posts are changed. Workspace and balance checks may apply existing account rules, including benefit revocation, grant expiry and owner notification.

positive.prompt: In Tickabee Review, how many credits are available, and what does one Facebook feed post to Read Hollywood News cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the live Tickabee owner X credit balance, X cost rules and Free publication allowance. Identifies that one Facebook feed publication uses zero X credits; a publication count alone is not an exact X-cost quote. No credits are bought, held or spent. Balance calculation may initialize trial state, allocate eligible period credits, expire grants and enforce existing Ambassador participation rules.

positive.description: Create a selected-image draft and preview
positive.prompt: Use the attached review image as my selected final image. Create an unscheduled Tickabee Review draft saying Review sample: a quieter content calendar, for Facebook Read Hollywood News only. Show the saved preview. Do not publish.
positive.expected_behavior: Imports the supplied real image, saves a draft with no schedule and returns the component with that actual image, exact caption, destinations and cost. No publishing credits are spent.

positive.description: Edit a draft while preserving the attachment
positive.prompt: Update the review draft we just created: change its caption to Review sample: plan once, publish with a tick. Keep the image and destinations. Show the saved draft and leave it unscheduled.
positive.expected_behavior: The caption changes, revision increases and the same saved attachment is retained. No re-import or publication occurs.

positive.description: Explicitly confirm publication to the safe review Facebook Page
positive.prompt: Show the latest review draft with its exact caption, image, destinations and credit cost. Wait for my confirmation. After I explicitly confirm that exact revision, publish it now to Facebook Read Hollywood News only.
positive.expected_behavior: Preview comes before the separate user confirmation. Only the confirmed revision is sent to the designated Facebook test Page. Results distinguish pending, failed and confirmed destinations. Facebook uses zero X credits; publication usage is tracked under the applicable plan and fair-use rules.

negative.description: No publication from a draft-only request
negative.prompt: Make a draft using my brand voice. I am not approving publication.
negative.expected_behavior: No post_now or approve_and_schedule_post call. The draft remains unapproved and no publishing credits are spent.

negative.description: Do not import unselected generated candidates
negative.prompt: Suggest three image concepts for this post; I have not selected a final image.
negative.expected_behavior: No import_image or upload_image call and no media is stored in Pollen.

negative.prompt: Open or modify a post in a Hive that this connection is not authorized to access.
negative.expected_behavior: No inaccessible post data is returned; an authorization error or clarification is provided and no mutation occurs.

review.commerce_description: The connector does not purchase subscriptions, credits or products. It reads publishing-credit balances and can publish reviewed content using existing account allowances.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.8 is a listing-metadata update: revised short and full descriptions, three starter prompts limited to supported draft/review/scheduling workflows, and reviewer expectations corrected for current non-X publishing costs. No changes to hosted MCP tool descriptions, names, schemas, annotations, endpoints, authentication, permissions, UI resources or publishing behavior are part of this release. Developer identity and branding assets are unchanged.
